name: Oil sands mining and froth treatment
aliases: Oil sands mining and froth treatment
principle: Oil sand is mined in open pits, crushed and mixed with 50 to 80 °C water so bitumen floats as froth (about 60% bitumen, 30% water, 10% solids), then diluent and settlers clean it. About two tons of sand yield a barrel, and tailings are the main environmental problem.
